_comment: Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct - BLAZING FAST mode - Maximum speed, minimal quality
_use_case: Fastest possible training - 30-45 minutes on 8 GPUs
_effective_batch: Effective batch size = 8 GPUs × 2 batch × 8 accumulation = 128 samples per update
_quality_warning: This config prioritizes SPEED over quality. Expect reduced performance.
_extreme_speed_optimizations: ✅ Only 2 LoRA modules (q_proj, v_proj) - 3.5x fewer parameters
✅ batch_size=2 per GPU - safe for RTX 2080 Ti (10.57 GB VRAM)
✅ Gradient checkpointing enabled - necessary for max_length=512
✅ Rare eval (200 steps) - minimal validation overhead
✅ No early stopping - no eval overhead
✅ Constant LR schedule - no schedule compute
✅ ignore_checkpoints=true - always start fresh (no resume overhead)
⚠️ Expected time: 45-60 minutes on 8 GPUs (slightly slower due to gradient checkpointing)
⚠️ Quality will be significantly lower than normal configs
